data.explanation: This letter confirms your sign-up for the adult guitar course starting in January 2027 and asks you to transfer the €216.00 course fee by the deadline shown using the given IBAN and payment reference. Note the letter actually names two different payment dates, so it is worth double-checking with the academy which one is correct before paying. If the fee does not arrive in time, the academy may not keep your place reserved. No other action is needed once payment is made; no legal remedy applies here as this is a private course booking, not an official decision.
